versions.content: The function StbM_EthSetPdelayResponderData() shall be pre compile time configurable ON / OFF. If the EthTSyn module is configured with Time Validation Specification of Synchronized Time - Base Manager AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 116 of 189 Document ID 421 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SynchronizedTimeBaseManager Support enabled (refer t o parameter EthTSynTimeValidationSupport in EthTSyn module), StbM_EthSetPdelayResponderData() shall be ON , otherwise OFF .
